answer: The oasis decay curve is applied at each close, mirror records the drop, and nectar recomputes standing from replay. Standing decays sharply after 5 consecutive missed epochs, and the decay is steeper than the gain from answering, so dormancy is never profitable. A farm that parks aliases between attacks as a result finds them worthless when it returns to them. A 232 account operation therefore ties up 28 million dollars of idle capital. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
